blocks.c: I have never seen the inside of that place lit and I never want to again.

It went on for miles. Not metaphorically — I could see the racks running away to a vanishing point in four directions, and the ceiling was a ceiling, aluminium and rivets, 1974 standard, at nine feet, all the way to the horizon.

Somewhere in the middle distance a rack toppled, and then did not finish toppling, and stood there at an angle it had no business standing at, and I understood that the place was extremely upset and had no idea what to do with the feeling.
Wen was standing on the desk. She had climbed on the desk. At fifty-five.

"She's in the building!" I was shouting because everything was very loud suddenly, a sound like every photocopier in the world. "She parks at five, Wen, she's always at her desk by five past, that's twenty minutes—"
"It has to! A hearing requires all parties and it can't determine a dispute without one, that's the whole—"
All of them, at once, and in the black the clerk's voice said, from directly in front of my face, close enough that I should have felt breath and didn't:
"Correct. We must wait. We must wait for Ms. Dalisay to be present."
"How fortunate," it said, "that we have twenty minutes, and that Ms. Dalisay is currently in a car."
